definitions.registered_users: Distinct voluntary human profiles. Registration requires name, email, and explicit current Privacy Notice consent; no Nimiq wallet is required.
definitions.consented_users: Registered profiles with a stored privacy notice version and consent timestamp.
definitions.wallet_linked_users: Registered profiles that proved control of a Nimiq wallet with a valid wallet signature.
definitions.registered_protocol_participants: Registered users whose verified linked wallet appears in protocol participation records.

evidence_boundary: Registration != wallet linking != protocol participation. Pre-registry test participation is excluded from real-user traction.
